hero.title: § 4–8 words: the Ionian from the deck of NIRIIS. Use '\n'.
hero.subtitle: § 1–2 sentences, max 32 words: daily cruises from Skala and Poros to Ithaca, Fiscardo and Zakynthos, two swims every trip, a family crew.

boat.title: § 'NIRIIS, built for these waters'
boat.body: § 2 short paragraphs (max 100 words): designed by the Captain from 30+ years of guest feedback; very quiet Volvo Penta IPS engines; stabilisers that reduce rolling by up to 70%; air-conditioned saloon with big windows; half-moon seating with tables so families sit together; four toilets, two bars; diving platform and water slide; ocean-going safety equipment.

kalypso.title: § 'Kalypso Star'
kalypso.body: § 2 sentences: semi-submarine trimaran built in France; watch marine life through underwater windows (49 seats below), sunset deck above; on request.
